name: Terser
title: Minify unchanged JavaScript assets
job: A build step sequentially minifies 149 independent, unchanged JavaScript assets in one Node process. A second build step minifies 7 unminified npm ES-module library dist files with webpack 5's production-default Terser options in one Node process.
operations: minify({filename: source}, webpack 5 production-default options for an ES-module asset)
editable: Terser production JavaScript under lib, within the existing task’s editable scope; retain upstream tests.
families: Complete JavaScript assets from distinct recorded repository groups in a frozen cdnjs catalog.
Unminified ES-module dist files from pinned npm package tarballs (registry.npmjs.org), one project lineage per group.
size_meaning: Original asset size and structure; 149 cdnjs files, 15,926,819 input bytes; 7 npm ES-module dist files, 5,558,785 input bytes.
options: cdnjs batch: one compression pass; mangling enabled; comments removed; source maps disabled. No unsafe or property-mangling options. webpack-esm: compress {passes: 2, ecma: 2015}, mangle, module, ecma 2015, source map undefined, and terser-webpack-plugin's extractComments comments callback (license comments extracted, none preserved in the code).
outputs: cdnjs batch: one complete minified JavaScript file per input. webpack-esm: one JSON document per input holding the complete minified code and the extracted license text. Each matches the pinned baseline byte length and SHA-256.
contract: Preserve the pinned output for this workload, all supported library behavior and the complete existing upstream test suite.
limits: Frontend-asset and npm ES-module library batch workloads, not all npm programs or API options.
preparation: Pinned SHA-256-checked Terser archive committed at /app/terser, locked npm closure, content-addressed original public assets and a prebuilt baseline. The driver imports main.js from the built production source; run upstream tests from /app/build/project to load the fresh CLI distribution.

source_identity.basis: Historical source identity retained for lineage; current source archive pin is in environment/source.lock.json.

input_edition_note: The public cdnjs batch excludes the Highmaps 6.0.3 input (cdnjs label CC-BY-NC-3.0), leaving 149 assets; every remaining input and its expected output is unchanged. Held-out inputs are unchanged.
